headline: Purell Integration Might Change The Case For Investing In Clorox Stock (CLX)
summary: Clorox has integrated the GOJO Purell acquisition into its portfolio, with the acquired business now contributing more than half of net sales and supporting the launch of the Clorox Purell ProCare professional hygiene platform in September 2026. The company is supporting a dividend payout currently above free cash flow.
